name: botclone
description: Multi-bot AI assistant platform: isolated context, per-bot persistent memory, per-bot sandbox, powered by the Claude API

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:prod -w server
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
